title: Facet panel + navigable geography in /browse/:type (proposal step 4)
description: Step 4 of research/category-taxonomy-proposal.md (human decisions 2026-10-16: UI English only; steps 4-6 ship before one Firebase deploy). Make the TASK-027 geo hierarchy and TASK-029 attrs.facets visible and usable. In app/src/views/EntityListView.vue (route /browse/:type) add a left-side FacetPanel (new app/src/components/FacetPanel.vue) fed by graph.json meta.facets[type] plus a geography block built from attrs.geo (country > subdivision > city, with counts). Each facet renders as a checkbox list with counts ("Florida (412)"), multi-select within a facet (OR) and AND across facets; range facets (loa_band, decade, berths_band, ...) render as band buttons, never min/max inputs; boolean facets as a toggle. Active filters appear as removable chips above DataTable; a "Clear all" control. Counts recompute against the CURRENT filtered set (faceted navigation semantics) and zero-count values are shown disabled, not hidden. Selection is encoded in the URL query (?country=US&subdivision=Florida&loa_band=24-40,40-60) so a filtered view is shareable and survives reload; the existing urlCodec in app/src/query/urlCodec.ts must keep decoding old links unchanged. Geography block drives /browse/marina?country=US&subdivision=Florida deep links and shows breadcrumb-style context (United States > Florida) above the table; each entity page (EntityView.vue) gets a small breadcrumb country > subdivision > city built from attrs.geo, each crumb linking to the filtered browse view. For yachts the 'complete' facet defaults to ON (identifiable only) with a visible chip the user can remove, so the 343 fragments are hidden unless asked for (proposal 5.5). Labels: human-readable English labels per facet key in app/src/utils/labels.ts (loa_band -> "Length (m)", facility_category -> "Facility type", ...). Must work at phone width (panel collapses to a "Filters (n)" button opening a drawer). Accessibility: keep Lighthouse a11y 100 and the existing /accessibility statement truthful (keyboard operable, aria-pressed on band buttons, fieldset/legend per facet). DataTable keeps its existing sort/paginate/CSV export over the filtered rows (CSV exports the filtered set). Performance: filtering 1,206 marinas with 5 active facets must stay under 50 ms in the store (precompute per-type facet indexes once in app/src/stores/graph.ts). No ingest changes in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: /browse/:type shows a FacetPanel listing every facet in meta.facets[type] plus a Geography block (country > subdivision > city from attrs.geo), each value with a count; counts recompute on the current filtered set and zero-count values render disabled (test with a fixture graph).

AC2: Multi-select is OR within a facet and AND across facets; range facets are band buttons; boolean facets are toggles; active filters show as removable chips with a Clear-all control; table rows and the row counter equal the engine result (unit test on the filter function with a fixture).

AC3: Selection round-trips through the URL query (country, subdivision, city, and every facet key; comma-separated multi-values); reload restores the same view; all existing urlCodec tests still pass and old /query links decode unchanged.

AC4: Deep link /browse/marina?country=US&subdivision=Florida shows only Florida marinas with breadcrumb 'United States > Florida'; EntityView shows a geo breadcrumb for any node with attrs.geo, each crumb linking to the corresponding filtered browse view; nodes without attrs.geo show no breadcrumb.
AC5: /browse/yacht defaults to the 'complete' facet ON with a visible chip; removing the chip reveals fragments; the default is applied only when the URL carries no explicit facet selection.

AC6: Phone width (375 px): panel collapses to a 'Filters (n)' button opening a drawer; no horizontal scroll; keyboard operable; Lighthouse accessibility stays 100 on /browse/marina and the a11y statement needs no correction (UAT step).

AC7: Precomputed facet indexes in the graph store; a benchmark-style unit test asserts filtering the real marina set with 5 active facets completes under 50 ms; CSV export exports exactly the filtered rows.
AC8: 142 existing app tests still green plus new tests <= AC count unless justified; typecheck and build clean; app/public/data/graph.json untouched.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
PEDIDO ESTRUCTURADO (PLANTILLA-PEDIDO), completado por el orquestador a partir del pedido en prosa del humano ("necesito que los filtros mejoren") y su decisión del 2026-10-16 (pasos 4, 5 y 6 antes de un solo deploy; UI inglés).
1. Objetivo: que un usuario pueda acotar cualquier lista de /browse/:type marcando casillas por categoría y por país/estado/ciudad, viendo cuántos resultados quedan, sin escribir texto.
2. Actor: usuario final del sitio DataYacht (lector, no editor).
3. Problema: hoy el único filtro es un formulario de query con operadores y texto libre; el usuario no sabe qué escribir; no existe "todas las marinas de Florida".
4. Caminos y acciones esperadas: principal: abrir /browse/marina -> panel con facetas y geografía con conteos -> marcar Florida y Dry stack -> tabla y contador se actualizan, chips arriba, URL cambia -> recargar conserva la vista -> exportar CSV exporta solo lo filtrado. Alternativo A: llegar por deep link /browse/marina?country=US&subdivision=Florida -> misma vista filtrada con breadcrumb. Alternativo B: desde una ficha (EntityView) pulsar la miga "Florida" -> lista filtrada. Alternativo C: /browse/yacht abre con el chip 'complete' puesto; quitarlo muestra los fragmentos. Alternativo D: móvil 375 px -> botón "Filters (n)" abre un cajón. Fallo: valor con 0 resultados en la selección actual -> se ve deshabilitado, no desaparece. Fallo: URL con un valor de faceta inexistente -> se ignora ese valor, el resto de la selección se aplica, sin error.
5. Criterios de hecho: AC1-AC8 del ticket.
6. Restricciones: no tocar ingest ni graph.json; urlCodec compatible con enlaces antiguos; Lighthouse a11y 100; filtrar 1,206 marinas con 5 facetas < 50 ms; 142 tests existentes en verde.
7. Fuera de alcance: query builder (TASK-031), buscador (TASK-032), deploy.

Measured on the real marina index: 500 junk values 1355 ms (AC7 budget 50 ms); growth 200->71 ms, 400->585, 800->4507, 2000->73443 ms. Fix: bound the lookahead to the max comma count of any value in that key's vocabulary, precomputed once in buildFacetIndex (real graph: 1 for club.city, 0 elsewhere), i.e. for j from min(parts.length, i+1+maxCommas[key]) down to i+2; lock with a test parsing 2000 comma values under 50 ms.
